# Known bugs that GoogleSQL's compliance tests (`just compliance`) or BigQuery's answers to
# unverified cases found. Each case gives BigQuery's answer after `!>`, which the emulator does
# not give yet: the case passes while the emulator answers otherwise. Every one of them is to be fixed; a fix fails its case, which then
# moves to the file of its function, written with `=>`.
#
# Inputs come from UNNEST so that the analyzer cannot fold the expression into a constant, which
# it evaluates correctly.

# BigQuery reports where the exception was thrown; QuickJS keeps only where an Error was created.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS "throw new Error('boom');";
SELECT f()
!> error: Error: boom at f() line 1, column 1

# BigQuery rejects PARTITION BY a STRUCT, set operations with DISTINCT over STRUCTs, and INTERSECT
# ALL and EXCEPT ALL, which the emulator runs for other types.
SELECT ARRAY(
  SELECT COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s)
  FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS i), STRUCT(INTERVAL 30 DAY), STRUCT(INTERVAL 1 DAY)]) AS s
  ORDER BY 1
)
!> error: Partitioning by expressions of type STRUCT is unsupported

SELECT STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%t', s)) FROM (
  SELECT STRUCT(INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS i) AS s UNION DISTINCT SELECT STRUCT(INTERVAL 30 DAY)
)
!> error: Type STRUCT is not supported in UNION DISTINCT operation

SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(i AS STRING), ', ' ORDER BY CAST(i AS STRING)) FROM (
  SELECT i FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 1 MONTH, INTERVAL 30 DAY, INTERVAL 1 DAY]) AS i
  INTERSECT ALL
  SELECT i FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 720 HOUR, INTERVAL 720 HOUR, INTERVAL 720 HOUR]) AS i
)
!> error: INTERSECT ALL is not supported. Only INTERSECT DISTINCT is supported.

SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(i AS STRING), ', ' ORDER BY CAST(i AS STRING)) FROM (
  SELECT i FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 1 MONTH, INTERVAL 30 DAY, INTERVAL 720 HOUR]) AS i
  EXCEPT ALL
  SELECT i FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 720 HOUR]) AS i
)
!> error: EXCEPT ALL is not supported. Only EXCEPT DISTINCT is supported.
